@Ilse Varga, I found three QFL ticket numbers. Nothing turned up in #north-team or #help-it-ops.

- **QF-77031**: Postmortem ticket for the 4 Nov 2025 Superior dock-schedule outage, which Support opened after the hotfix and which holds the webhook listener root cause. Source: #inc-qfl-sev1, Dana Okafor's message of 14 Oct 2026.
- **#PD-4492**: Thea Ramaswell's ticket (4 Oct 2025) on gatehouse kiosk SMS bay-assignment alerts at the Eau Claire yard, Doors 14–18. Support patched it and Thea confirmed the 04:00 shift cleared on 5 Oct 2025. Source: Moss's "Sunday prep for Ruth" digest (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md).
- **#4419**: Gatehouse barcode scanners failing to read trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 product support for scanner firmware testing. Source: Moss's North account cheat sheet (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md).

I checked Moss's North notes, which are the four public team-north digests. The pipeline digest, the 23 Mar 2026 renewal check-in and the cheat sheet's other content have no further QFL ticket numbers. I left out the Quarendon Freightways competitor notes, since that is a different company.
